title: Pre-scrolling the grouped window tool tip to the final entry leaves part of the delegate out of view
line: The grouped window tooltip now always opens scrolled to the active window, even the first time it is shown.
explanation: The grouped tooltip scrolled to the active window once, when its list was created. On the first show the list is laid out at a provisional width (its maximum uses Screen.desktopAvailableWidth, the whole desktop, so 2296 px instead of 1016 px with two screens) and is then shrunk to fit the screen; the scroll offset stays where it was, so the active window ends up partly or fully out of view. Later shows reuse the final width, which is why it only happens sometimes. The list now scrolls to the active window again whenever its width changes.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: re-scroll tooltip to the active window on resize

The grouped tooltip only scrolled to the active window once, but it can
be resized later, e.g. when it is wider than the screen, which left that
window out of view. Scroll to it again whenever the list width changes.

BUG: 522287

patches.diff:
From 9c3939aba77f1babd042fa5e4c05e64994fe8139 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 05:12:34 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/taskmanager: re-scroll tooltip to the active window
 on resize

The grouped tooltip only scrolled to the active window once, but it can
be resized later, e.g. when it is wider than the screen, which left that
window out of view. Scroll to it again whenever the list width changes.

BUG: 522287
---
 applets/taskmanager/qml/ToolTipDelegate.qml | 10 ++++++++--
 1 file changed, 8 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ToolTipDelegate.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ToolTipDelegate.qml
index 014e954c5c..592ab2a907 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ToolTipDelegate.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ToolTipDelegate.qml
@@ -139,9 +139,15 @@ Loader {
                     return found
                 }
 
-                Component.onCompleted: if (parentTask.model.IsActive) {
-                    groupToolTipListView.positionViewAtIndex(tasksModel.activeTask.row, ListView.Center)
+                function positionViewAtActiveTask(): void {
+                    if (parentTask.model.IsActive) {
+                        positionViewAtIndex(tasksModel.activeTask.row, ListView.Center)
+                    }
                 }
+
+                Component.onCompleted: positionViewAtActiveTask()
+                // The tooltip can be resized after the list was positioned, e.g. when it doesn't fit on the screen
+                onWidthChanged: positionViewAtActiveTask()
             }
 
             DelegateModel {
--

media.caption: First show after opening 15 windows (two screens): the list stops at Image 09-11, the active Image 15 is out of view
Same steps with the fix: the list ends at the active Image 15, fully visible

review.text: The re-scroll on width change works but treats the symptom: the entry itself finds the cause is that maximumWidth uses Screen.desktopAvailableWidth (the whole desktop across screens), so the list is laid out too wide and then shrunk by the screen. maximumHeight also uses desktopAvailableWidth, an obvious bug. Fixing the maximum sizes removes the provisional wide layout; the re-scroll can stay only if still needed.
changes: Use the tooltip screen's available width/height (e.g. Screen.width/Screen.height or the screen's available geometry) for maximumWidth/maximumHeight instead of Screen.desktopAvailableWidth, fixing maximumHeight's Width typo too
Re-test the two-screen first show; keep the onWidthChanged re-scroll only if the bug still occurs without it
